title: Body Focus
description: Keeps the tracked body clear while softly treating the surrounding image.

parameters.label: Effect
parameters.description: Strength of the treatment outside the tracked body.

parameters.label: Body Width
parameters.description: Width of the clear area around the tracked body.

parameters.label: Body Height
parameters.description: Height of the clear area around the tracked body.

parameters.label: Desaturate
parameters.description: Colour removed from the surrounding image.

parameters.label: Background Dim
parameters.description: Darkness applied outside the tracked body.

parameters.label: Background Tint
parameters.description: Tint used in the treated background.

parameters.label: Skeleton
parameters.description: Brightness of the tracked body structure.

parameters.label: Skeleton Colour
parameters.description: Colour of the tracked body structure.
